svg.title: Stigmergy, the ant scale K and crumb size
svg.desc: Double-bridge experiment with equal and unequal branches, the ant scale K against the syscall rate, and the crumb radius against bytes per syscall.
svg.text: Anthill: what a pheromone trail does, and two of the view's transforms
A marked branch attracts more ants (Deneubourg model, k = 20, n = 2); K and the crumb curve are the specified mappings of the view.
